data.name: A Teaspoon of Transcendence
data.passiveDescription:
ATK is increased by {{28//35//42//49//56%}}.
Additionally, each time the equipping character hits an opponent with their Charged Attack, they attain “Transcendence” for a short time: their Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG is increased by {{16//20//24//28//32%}} for 5s. This effect can stack once every 0.2s, max 3 stacks.
